_comment: Known-good song fixture for the offline Athan path: PDF2PDF-style Flex Data UMPs. Tempo 120, key C major, chords C7 -> Dm7 -> G7 -> clear -> C7. Words built per MIDI 2.0 UMP spec (mt=0xD, group 0, format 0, bank 0): header=(0xd<<28)|(status), chord w1=(sf<<28)|(tonicLetter<<24)|(chordType<<16), keysig w1=(sf<<28)|(tonicLetter<<24). Letters A=1..G=7.
